next.reason: 1985 GR25: 'The minimum and maximum record sizes for a file are established at the time the file is created and must not subsequently be changed.' §2023:9.1.6 (prose, no catalog rule id) says the same: fixed attributes 'apply to the file at the time it is created and cannot be changed throughout the lifetime of the file', listing 'the minimum and maximum logical record size in bytes'. The catalogued parts: §2023:9.1.13.2 GR3 names the 'minimum or maximum length of records allowed for the fixed file attributes', and §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10 compares the program's attributes 'with the fixed file attributes of the file' at OPEN (status 39), as 1985 GR8's file attribute conflict did. Same meaning; the primary statement lives in uncatalogued 9.1.6.
